description: SYNTHETIC data for the Counterparty Credit Exposure and Limit Monitoring project. All counterparties, trades, valuations, collateral, ratings and limits are fictional.
business_calendar: pandas.bdate_range Monday-Friday index; NOT an exchange or settlement holiday calendar.

scenario_counterparties.description: Netting set with +5.0m (gently oscillating) and -1.0m GBP trades against a 10m GBP limit; utilisation about 40%.
USD trades netting to about 11.3m USD (about 8.9m GBP) against a 10m GBP limit; utilisation between 80% and 100% on every date.
EUR exposure ramps linearly from 8m to 16m EUR against a 14m EUR limit; status moves Within Limit -> Warning -> Breach.
+2.0m GBP exposure with an approved limit of 0.
Only negative MTM (payable) trades in a netting set; exposure 0 with a limit of 0.
Only limit expires (effective_to exclusive) on 2026-02-16; no effective limit from that date.
No rating record at all; reported as Unrated and flagged.
Limit cut from 15m to 9m GBP effective 2026-02-23 against stable 8m GBP exposure; Within Limit -> Warning.
+3.0m GBP exposure with 5.0m GBP eligible cash collateral received; net exposure floored at 0, 2.0m surplus unused.
+6.0m and -4.0m GBP trades in a netting-permitted set; pre-collateral exposure 2.0m.
+6.0m and -4.0m GBP trades in a non-netting set; pre-collateral exposure 6.0m; 1.0m collateral on the set is unsupported and not recognised.
Set 01: +2.0m exposure with 5.0m collateral (3.0m surplus). Set 02: +4.0m with no collateral. Counterparty exposure is 4.0m, not 1.0m.
+4.0m GBP trade matures 2026-02-13 (excluded from that date; reported MATURED for three days, then dropped); +1.0m long-dated trade remains.
2.0m EUR bond collateral marked ineligible; not recognised; exposure stays 3.0m GBP.
Collateral posted by the reporting entity (direction POSTED) is flagged and not recognised as an offset.
Constant +5,000,000.00 GBP exposure against a 5,000,000 GBP limit; At Limit within tolerance.

conventions.mtm_sign: Positive = receivable to the reporting entity; negative = payable by the reporting entity.
conventions.fx: GBP amount = local amount x gbp_per_unit; GBP rate = 1.
conventions.maturity_feed: Trades are reported ACTIVE up to and including maturity date, MATURED with MTM 0 for three business days afterwards, then dropped.
conventions.termination_feed: Terminated trades are reported TERMINATED with MTM 0 for two business days, then dropped.
conventions.background_limits: Background counterparty limits are set to simulated peak exposure x U(1.3, 3.0), except three 'tight' counterparties at x U(0.95, 1.2), converted at first-date FX and rounded up to 100,000.
conventions.control_totals: Built from the raw string tables before downstream processing: row counts and signed local-currency amount totals by table/date/currency.
